summary: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. III (SPAC, 'Mach X') filed an 8-K announcing entry into a Business Combination Agreement on August 24, 2026, with Ursa Major Technologies, Inc. ('Ursa Major') and its wholly-owned merger subsidiary. Per the agreement, the merger sub will merge with and into Ursa Major, with Ursa Major surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mach X. Mach X will domestication from Cayman Islands to Delaware and be renamed to a mutually agreed name. The transaction is subject to shareholder approvals and other closing conditions. No deal terms (valuation, PPS, premium) were disclosed in this excerpt. Key watch items: SPAC shareholder redemption rate, regulatory approvals, and closing timeline.
